MADHU B HORAKERI madhubh219@gmail.com / +91 9148023058

PROFILE SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience delivering Banking, SaaS, and E-Procurement solutions across Agile environments. Experienced in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, business process analysis, API integrations, UAT, release management, and production deployments. Skilled at translating business requirements into functional solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and driving successful project delivery using JIRA, Postman, SQL, and Agile methodologies. Strong domain expertise in T24, ITSM/CSM platforms, and enterprise SaaS applications.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Wolken Software | Senior Business Analyst

Bangalore, India | July 2025 – Present

Led client onboarding by conducting product demonstrations, configuring enterprise SaaS solutions, and ensuring successful product adoption.

Gathered client API integration requirements, collaborated with developers to configure new REST APIs, and validated endpoints, request/response payloads, authentication, and functionality using Postman to support UAT and successful client delivery.

Deployed application releases to the Sandbox (SB) environment, performed post-deployment validation, collaborated with Development and QA teams to resolve regression defects, and ensured successful production-ready releases.

Elicited, analyzed, and documented business requirements by collaborating with clients and stakeholders, translating business needs into user stories, functional specifications, and prioritized backlog items.

Reduced the Broadcom ticket backlog from 50+ to ~20 tickets by collaborating with Development, DevOps, and QA teams, improving issue resolution efficiency.

Owned end-to-end delivery of ITSM and CSM portal enhancements, from requirement gathering and solution design through UAT, deployment, and successful production go-live.



Led the implementation of the Case Summary enhancement by integrating the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), improving operational visibility and service efficiency.

Configured and optimized SLA policies, Business Rules, workflows, and status/sub-status models across ITSM and CSM modules to streamline service management processes.

Configured JIRA workflows, issue types, statuses, and lifecycle processes, improving project tracking, process standardization, and team productivity.



Facilitated Sprint Reviews, client demonstrations, and stakeholder walkthroughs to gather feedback, validate business requirements, and drive feature adoption.



Performed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on recurring production issues and recommended process improvements to enhance system stability and customer satisfaction.

Delivered the CSG PRISM project by designing end-to-end user journey workflow diagrams using Whimsical, improving process visualization and user experience.

Temenos India Pvt Ltd | Business Analyst

Bangalore, India | Feb 2024 – June 2025

• Applied functional expertise in Temenos Transact (T24) across Lending (LD), Payment Due (PD), COB,

and OFS modules to support implementation and production support activities.

• Collaborated with business stakeholders and development teams to deliver client-specific banking solutions

across Lending (LD), Payment Due (PD), and COB modules.

Managed end-to-end T24 implementation activities, including requirement analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), functional testing, and issue resolution, reducing average resolution time by 25%.

Developed data extraction and data correction routines using InfoBasic (JBC), Design Studio, and JQL, improving data reconciliation and operational efficiency.

Created Knowledge Base (KB) articles and technical documentation, improving knowledge sharing, process documentation, and analyst onboarding.

DXC TECHNOLOGY | Business Analyst

Bangalore, India | Nov 2021 – Dec 2023

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements for the Karnataka e-Procurement platform,



ensuring alignment with stakeholder objectives. Translated business requirements into functional specifications and user stories for e-Sourcing, e- Tendering, and e-Auction modules.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), reducing issue resolution

time by 20%.

Analyzed application logs and business data to generate actionable insights and support business decision- making.

Validated defect fixes, documented business impact, and supported application testing to ensure solution quality.

SKILLS

Technical Skills: MySQL, Oracle SQL, InfoBasic (JBC) • Tools: JIRA, Postman, DBeaver, Jenkins, Whimsical, Bugzilla, SQLyog, Microsoft 365 • Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering, Stakeholder Management, User Stories, BRD, FRD, Functional Specifications, Gap Analysis, Process Mapping, Impact Analysis, API Integration, UAT, Release Management, Agile, Scrum, SDLC, Documentation, Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

Domain Expertise: Temenos Transact (T24), Lending (LD), Payment Due (PD), Core Banking, SaaS, ITSM, CSM, E-Procurement

PROJECTS

Wolken ServiceDesk: ITSM & CSM Portal Enhancements, JIRA Workflow Configuration, CSG (PRISM, Arctera, Backup Exec, Citrix, TIBCO), Broadcom

Temenos India: Temenos Transact (T24) – Lending (LD), Payment Due (PD), COB • DXC Technology: Karnataka Government e-Procurement (GoK) & KPP Portal

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Science Engineering Visvesvaraya Technological University.
